symbols.name: PotoPlayer
symbols.doc: Play a .poto story: <PotoPlayer src="/assets/x.poto" controls autoplay muted />; still + time shows one frame. Events zeb:potoru:ready / report / ended / error; window.__zebPotoru.get(id).

symbols.name: PotoSnapshot
symbols.doc: A still frame of a story: <PotoSnapshot src="/assets/x.poto" time={1.5} />. Thumbnails, galleries, storyboards; no engines, no sound. window.__zebPotoru.get(id).seek(t).

symbols.name: PotoEditor
symbols.doc: Editor: <PotoEditor yaml={files} />, YAML / Script modes. Events zeb:potoru-editor:compiled / error; window.__zebPotoEditor.get(id).

symbols.name: potoru
symbols.doc: zeb/potoru namespace: version, get(id), getEditor(id), mountPotoPlayer, mountPotoEditor, compile.

symbols.name: mountPotoPlayer
symbols.doc: mountPotoPlayer(host, { src, controls, autoplay, muted, loop, mode, height }) → Promise<instance>.

symbols.name: mountPotoSnapshot
symbols.doc: mountPotoSnapshot(host, { src, time, camera, fit, height }) → Promise<instance> (seek(t) redraws).

symbols.name: compile
symbols.doc: compile({ yaml } | { script, yaml? }) → Promise<{ ok, poto, diagnostics, files, sizes }>. Also potoru.compile.
